description: We are a best-friends group from high school that are now in first year of university and we are ready to grow together with this hackathon. We have been here before and is now a tradition to come here every year and give our best to continue gaining experience, knowledge and fun. We are varied in skills, having teammates specialized in chemistry, mecatronics, aeronautics, design and visual skills. We are full by the moment, but we will be happy to meet you in the hackathon! See you there!
